sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ba/-be expresses movement into a place or destination. It contrasts with -ban/-ben for being inside a place.

-ba/-be answers ‘into where,’ a different question from -ban/-ben’s ‘inside where’ — English blurs this with different prepositions (‘go to’ vs ‘be in’), but Hungarian marks the distinction directly on the noun every time. Once motion versus rest feels like a grammatical fact rather than a vocabulary choice, other suffix pairs later in the course click faster.
